name: Build Shelter
placementTarget: The back of each player reference card. Sticker-07 is the line that says so.
summary: Build Shelter. Discard a card matching the color of your current city to build a shelter there. Shelters prevent characters from getting exposed. A shelter icon sits at the bottom. No printed code. This is the short player-aid line. The full action, including moving a shelter when none are left, is Rule N.

mechanics.timing: Reminder of the Build Shelter action, read during a turn.
mechanics.effect: Discard a City card of your current city's color to build a shelter in that city. A shelter stops characters there from being exposed.
restrictions: This aid does not print the 'move an existing shelter' line, the protection for characters who are leaving, or the game-end population exceptions. Those are on Rule N.
Sticker-07 says to put this sticker on the back of each player reference card.
No printed code and no production cost.
